TEXT:
[FI] Meanwhile, the game development steadily 
continues.

[FI] As for our situation a week before the cultural 
festival, we were in a tight spot.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I finished the script. Please go through it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Okay, I'll look at it now!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] ...With all the rushing of work, I don't even know 
what I'm writing about anymore...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I'll edit where you left off, so you don't have to 
worry about it!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Still, talk about being good at what you like doing... 
Even if this turns into a scene of carnage, Sena 
probably won't even stop.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Even though most of the guys are down already.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] You and him are the only remaining ones alive, 
aren't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] When it comes to endurance, that's where I'm most 
confident! I can go on for 2, even 3 days without 
sleep!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I can't believe this guy is actually being useful at 
the very end...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] Hey, Makabe! I found something strange again. 
Wake up and fix this!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] Ah... You found a bug...? Then, I'll wake up... Prez...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: [FI] Okay, okay, naptime's over...

[FI] Even through the constant turmoil, the day of the 
cultural festival arrived.

[FI] The game research club's newest RPG 
"Brotherhood" made its debut to the entire school.

[FI] That's right, we finished the day of the cultural 
festival! Or I should say, we somehow made it in 
time. Despite being at death's door, though.
[FI] A-As for how well it was received...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Th-This is...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I was doubtful about finishing it, but I listened to 
what you said and worked with all my energy and 
now, it is complete! Thank you!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ummm, what did I even say...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Yes well, something like, "Be more honest with your 
interests!"

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I see, thanks to that...

[FI] The finished game actually turned into a hardcore 
homo RPG at the end.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] ...Akagi-san. When did the character names become 
Akagi and Kyousuke...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Well, it just didn't seem right if I didn't name them 
that. Of course, I didn't modify the scripts you 
wrote.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] And the character illustrations, when did they 
become more like me and Akagi...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Ehehehe. I was honest with the image in my mind 
when I made them.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] I wonder how you even had enough time to 
redraw the CGs...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] When you wrestle with something you love, you can 
work more than twice as fast.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Through this experience, I understood it well. Like 
your 6 kilobytes-per-hour writing, it's a speed you 
can achieve because it's a subject you love.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Fufu... Fufufufufu...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] W-What's wrong, Kuroneko? Why are you laughing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] That's right... it has to be that way... The true 
pleasure of doujins...! The culmination of 
self-satisfaction...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Ignoring all the pressure and restraints, slipping 
under even the creators' noses, squeezing in all the 
rotten materials into this path of bloodshed.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] As I expected, you are no ordinary person. My 
judgment was not wrong, having granted you the 
title of The Mystic Eyes...

[FI] I don't get it, but seems like Kuroneko is seeing 
Sena as a rival in a whole new level now...

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] U-Umm... Can I ask something? This character 
jealous about the relationship between Akagi and 
Kyousuke and always being tortured by them...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Who else do you think resembles him?

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=26]Riiiighhhht!? No matter how you look at 
this character, I'm the model, right??[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I put a considerable amount of effort into the 
scene where you get disabled, so please look 
forward to it!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=18]This game... is being released in the school's cultural festival, 
right...[/font_size][font_size=15]Right...?[/font_size]

[FI] Forget the game, the real Makabe looks like he's 
disabled already...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It was... pretty well-received.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] I-Is that so...

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] The people who played it had fun. The anime club 
members even praised us, going "This looks pretty 
professional."

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] I'm just glad that more people came. Until now, not 
many people even came to look at our works.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] I got some people from the soccer club to come 
too!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Well, it didn't really matter if they were here 
anyway...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: [FI] Hey, rejoice everyone! I bring some good news.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, President. Where have you been?

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] I thought I might do something a club president 
would normally do.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] Using the game's high approval, I negotiated with 
the teachers. They might increase our club funding 
from now on.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] Really!
[FI] Makabe grabbed onto his hands and hopped in joy.

[FI] To be honest, even I was doing a triumphant "guts 
pose" in my mind. I'm happy the thing we made 
was well-received...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...It seems this was a big success. Good for you.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah...! Thanks to everyone! Thank you very much!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Now then, our hardship was rewarded... Now that 
it's over, I've gotten rather sleepy...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] Whoa now, it's a bit early to rest. Let's celebrate 
with a party? I'm hungry.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] That sounds nice, I'll go buy some stuff. I wonder if 
the food stands are still open?

[FI] Thus, the cultural festival ended, and the modest 
party in the club room ended as well.

[FI] Not too long afterward, only Sena and I remained, 
cleaning up after the party.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] ...So you haven't slept for three days, right? Leave 
the rest of the cleaning to me; you can go home 
and rest up.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] I'm fine, I don't mind cleaning up.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] That and, I'm so excited I can't calm myself down... 
It would be a waste if I just went home.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, I know that feeling. When I went to Comiket, I 
felt the same way.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah. After an event like this, the fun, the pain, the 
feeling of accomplishment... all these various feelings 
mixed together, I can't express it in words.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah.

[FI] I kept up this casual conversation, but my heart's 
pounding like crazy.

[FI] That's because... I could feel a sense of 
determination coming from Sena's behavior.
[FI] With only time passing, the cleaning's almost done...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Um... Senpai.
